reading: Japan had a powerful earthquake recently.
After the main quake, there were many smaller quakes.
These smaller quakes are called aftershocks.
More than 100 aftershocks hit the country.
Officials say these aftershocks could be strong.
People are urged to stay alert.
Staying alert means being ready for danger.
It is important to stay safe in affected areas.

vocabulary.definition: A sudden strong shaking of the ground.
Smaller earthquakes that happen after a big one.
People in important positions, often in the government.
Watching and ready for danger or something important.
A measure of the size or power of an earthquake.

entries.ja: 地面が突然激しく揺れること。
entries.es: Un movimiento fuerte y repentino de la tierra.
entries.pt-BR: Um tremor forte e repentino da terra.

entries.ja: 大きな地震の後に起こる、より小さな地震。
entries.ko: 큰 지진 후에 발생하는 더 작은 지진들.
entries.zh-Hans: 在大地震之后发生的较小的地震。
entries.es: Terremotos más pequeños que ocurren después de uno grande.
entries.pt-BR: Tremores de terra menores que acontecem depois de um grande.

entries.ja: 重要な地位にいる人々、しばしば政府の。
entries.ko: 중요한 직위에 있는 사람들, 대개 정부의.
entries.zh-Hans: 担任重要职位的人，通常在政府中。
entries.es: Personas en puestos importantes, a menudo en el gobierno.
entries.pt-BR: Pessoas em posições importantes, muitas vezes no governo.

entries.ja: 危険や何か重要なことに注意を払っていて、準備ができている状態。
entries.ko: 위험하거나 중요한 것에 대해 주시하고 준비가 되어 있는.
entries.zh-Hans: 警惕并准备好应对危险或重要的事情。
entries.es: Observando y listo para el peligro o algo importante.
entries.pt-BR: Observando e pronto para o perigo ou algo importante.

entries.ja: 地震の大きさや強さを測る尺度。
entries.zh-Hans: 衡量地震大小或强度的单位。
entries.es: Una medida del tamaño o la fuerza de un terremoto.
entries.pt-BR: Uma medida do tamanho ou poder de um terremoto.
